text:
Marta S.: Hi team  I'm Marta, starting on-call next week. Two quick things: how do I get phone call escalation (some customers want voice), and where's the practice incident checklist?
Theo R.: Welcome Marta :wave: Phone escalation is handled in PD -> profile -> contact methods. Add mobile and set escalation rule to call. I'll send a screenshot in DM.
Marta S.: I only see SMS, not calls. Is that restricted?
Devexbot: auto: If mobile call not visible, request 'pager-call-access' via Okta. Submit at https://okta.example.com/app/requests/new and tag "oncall-phone". Reviewer: @Samir K..
Samir K.: Yup I'll approve. Also confirm your mobile in HR so PD accepts it (we sync from People Ops).
Marta S.: Noted. About practice incidents  I want to run a mock postmortem with my mentor.
Theo R.: We keep a repo of reproducible staging incidents: infra/playbooks/mock-incidents. Use the runner: `python tools/mock_incident_runner.py --scenario latency`
Marta S.: I don't have repo access yet.
Infra Bot: auto: Grant request: repo infra/playbooks - please open a git access ticket via Okta form. Link: https://git.example.com/access-requests
Marta S.: Also curious: how fresh are the runbooks? I opened "auth-timeout" and it looks older.
Theo R.: Good catch. We tag runbooks with a freshness badge. If last updated >180 days, they get a "needs-review" flag. Ping #docs-review to queue an update.
Marta S.: Is there a short list of must-read runbooks for first 48h?
Samir K.: Yes - minimal set: "Incident Triage", "Auth Timeouts", "Key Rotation & KMS", "PG Restore Playbook", "Severity Matrix". Read before your first shadow. Links: https://confluence.redwood/infer/eng-oncall/runbooks/minimal-48h
Marta S.: How do I swap a shift across timezones? My partner is in CET and wants a swap.
Theo R.: Use PagerDuty schedule -> Request Override -> set the timezone in the override. Then post a note in #eng-oncall with the swap link. For urgent swaps <6h, DM me or Samir.
Marta S.: Good. Any tips for reading logs fast?
Samir K.: Use LogLens (loglens.redwood). Query shortcuts: `service:<svc> last:15m error` and `trace:correlation_id` to jump to related spans.
Marta S.: OK, final one: access to customer keys for triage? Temporary creds ok?
Devexbot: auto: KMS access requests must include justification and duration. Use https://kms.redwood/request and set duration 14 days with tag "oncall-temp". Ops will issue short-lived creds.
Marta S.: Thanks all  any scheduled training I should finish before my first shift?
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete "Oncall Foundations" async module and the interactive drill in staging by EOD Friday. Link: https://learn.redwood/oncall-foundations. Live drill scheduled Sat 18:00 UTC with mentor Theo R..
Theo R.: I'll run the live drill. Plan: 30m walkthrough + 2 simulated incidents (15m each). Meet in #eng-oncall or join zoom (link sent).
Marta S.: Wonderful, I'll finish the module today and start the mock incidents once I get repo access. Thanks everyone!
Samir K.: Welcome aboard Marta. We'll keep your first week light and make sure you have a mentor on every shift. Ping if anything blocks.
thread_summary: Marta (new hire) asks about phone escalation, practice incidents, runbook freshness, timezone swaps, log tools, and access workflows for on-call onboarding
